newsitem.title: UK: Exports and imports growth trends steady in Nov - Mitsubishi.
newsitem.headline: Exports and imports growth trends steady in Nov - Mitsubishi.

text.p: The index of future U.S. air cargo business rose 0.2 percent to 529.6 in November, compared to a 1.4 percent gain in October, the Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi said.

In its latest Foreign Trade survey of air freight carriers, seaports and trucking firms released here on Thursday, the bank's New York economic research department figures show the index of air cargo trade activity in November rose 3.9 percent to 462.3, the second largest gain in 1996 with the exception of a 5.2 percent increase in September. The air cargo trade index had risen 2.3 percent in October.
The November index of air cargo export business was up 0.6 percent at 594.2 whilst that for import business up 1.7 percent at 407.0.
There was a steep jump in the current air cargo import conditions which gained 5.8 percent, which apart from September's 8.9 percent gain was the steepest rise since September 1995.
Air cargo export expectations was unchanged at 647.5 while import expectations rose 0.5 percent to 411.8.

The index is an equally weighted composite index of current export and import air cargo activity (not seasonally adjusted and 1989 equals 100). - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017.
